notes.title: End of August update
notes.notes:
https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_complete03.jpg?w=611

Hi people!

Time for a new updates after the usual weekly meeting - this week x2 :P.
Sector-10 is having some minor palette changes on last part and we are thinking where to put the interactive PCs for the story infos. Plus now the rooms have names and it was stress-tested.

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_ui.jpg?w=611

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_piece01.jpg?w=611

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_piece02.jpg?w=611

On other things: we added in the hints list a new one for switching between the SynBs, with the mouse wheel, and fixed some texts.
We have changed the position of an info PC in Sector-1, because there were too many in a room and we are adding a new info text that will appear during the first fight with the Kebre - here:

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/sec01-pcs.jpg?w=611

We added another 2 achievements, one for the last Sector and one for the Yellow Ray, just like the blue and the green one.
So right now we have added all the achievements from our list (last Sectors, end game...) + some more, everything is ready and uploaded on STEAM. We just need to finish last stuff and upload a new version and complete the end scene.

Alessio is changing the levels for adding some collectable items following a list we wrote months ago.

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_trophy.jpg

Of course this has also a specific new achievements. Here 3 of the icons:

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/achiviconsnew1.jpg

The idea of the collectable items is also "related" to a new feature of the game you will see soon.
Alessio is working on an exporter/converter for all the languages texts - when it will be ready we will have the possibility to manage all the texts... just to time for making the translation ;)

Go-go-go! ;) Take care,

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: Update: intro!
notes.notes:
https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_intro.gif?w=660

Hi again!

We have a new update, just for the week end so you can play happy again with you favorite THE BODY CHANGER ^_^.

First of all, as told, we have finally a intro for the game with a better introduction to the story, more info about what's going on and how you got involved with the no-end mission.
We used 3D cut-scenes made with game engine plus some 2D gfx for building fake e-mails. We are pretty sure you will like it. ;)
Of course you need to start a new game for seeing it.

We fixed also other stuff (maybe take a look to  STEAM discussion for more details...) and added more info for some puzzles here and there. We added also some automatic position change for the camera, for making some things more clear: we are trying to avoid situations where you do some action and you hear a sound but it's not clear what's going on.

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_cameras.jpg?w=660

Because we thought that using the Dart Shock Beam could be difficult sometimes we added an animated "crosshair":

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_dartaiming.jpg?w=660

Have you seen it in the screenshot from last news? ;) You still need to be precise but at least you have a better idea where you will throw your Shock Beam - here's a super short video that shows how cool the animation is:

https://youtu.be/MoNFq8O8YoU

EHI! We finally have uploaded the cards, wallpapers and the emoticons! Sadly I found out that I forgot to make 3 wallpapers, so this week-end will be time to finish the job :P

We had also the opportunity the install the game on a Microsoft Surface (with Windows 8) and it works perfectly:

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/2015-05-07-22-01-09.jpg?w=660 https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_onsurface.jpg?w=660The resolution of 2160x1440 pixel is quite amazing :D

Ok that's all for today, enjoy the game and tell your friends!
And don't forget to share us your thoughts and comments, together we can make the game even better!

Take care,

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: Let's celebrate the UBUNTU release with a DISCOUNT!
notes.notes:
https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/01/tbc_linuxsale.jpg?w=660

Hi all!
With the new version for UBUNTU we put THE BODY CHANGER on a DISCOUNT PRICE for a limited period of time so grab your copy now if you haven't already!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/324390

The current version, if you don't know, has 5 complete Sectors/levels with tons of Action and a lot of puzzles, a 1 main story mode and 3 different arena modes with distinct game mechanic but all action oriented and with a nice arcade feeling!
Sector 6 is in coming soon - almost done:

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/01/screenshot_0003.jpg?w=660

and here a sneak peek of the upcoming WIP Sector-07

https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/01/tbc_sector7scr_0031.jpg?w=660


Still not sure? Take a look to another nice video on YouTube, this time from the nice MegaGWolf:

http://youtu.be/XRofEOYzGzM

Enjoy and please share!


TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: THE BODY CHANGER: Linux UBUNTU version ready!
notes.notes:
https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/01/tbc_linuxubuntu1.jpg

Finally THE BODY CHANGER is available also on UBUNTU! 
After some hard work during last Christmas, everything seems to work as it should, as you can see from the new screenshots, below. The port took some time but it was worth it.

Please note that the requested version of Ubuntu is 14.04.1 and as usual if you want to give us some feedback, please let us know in the technical discussion. 

Here some screens from UBUNTU version:


http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/28/27877/thumb_620x2000/tbc_linux_01.jpg

http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/28/27877/thumb_620x2000/tbc_linux_02.jpg

And it works perfectly also windowed: 

http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/28/27877/thumb_620x2000/tbc_linux_03.jpg

http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/28/27877/thumb_620x2000/tbc_linux_04.jpg

So after this little digression we are currently building a new area and designing new puzzles for the next Sector. 
The new area was in the begin a part from the new Sector but then we decide to change a bit things here and there and.. you will see. ;)

So with next news you will have maybe some new screens - and don't forget that Sector 6 is almost done but need to be added to the main game flow so very soon also this part will be available.

Until next time take care and have a great time,

TheShortAndTheTall
